intended_object: The n-truncation functor from cosimplicial objects in C (functors Δ ⥤ C) to n-truncated cosimplicial objects (functors Δ_{≤n} ⥤ C). It restricts a cosimplicial object along the inclusion Δ_{≤n} ↪ Δ. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
A cosimplicial object in C is a functor Δ ⥤ C. An n-truncated cosimplicial object is a functor Δ_{≤n} ⥤ C, where Δ_{≤n} is the full subcategory of Δ on the objects [0], …, [n]. The standard truncation functor is precomposition with the inclusion Δ_{≤n} ↪ Δ.

The definition is exactly this. It takes `(whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj (SimplexCategory.Truncated.inclusion n)`, the functor given by precomposing with the inclusion.

It works for an arbitrary category C and every n : ℕ, which is the natural generality. It mirrors `SimplicialObject.truncation`, and Mathlib has no other declaration for this construction.
